StudentProgress.title: Student Thesis Progress
StudentProgress.description: Progress tracking for a student's thesis milestones and number-line stages

studentId.description: Unique identifier for the student or Auth UID

thesisTopic.description: Title or research topic of the thesis

currentPhase.description: Active thesis phase (1: Proposal Defense, 2: Final Defense)

currentStepNumber.description: The latest forward step global number reached (1-27)

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL from Google Auth

completedSteps.description: List of completed milestone step IDs across both phases. Strictly append-only (cannot delete).

stepNotes.description: Custom notes or reminders recorded for each step

stepDates.description: Completion or target date recorded for each step

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the latest update

/student_progress/{studentId}.description: Collection of student thesis progress number-line records
